subjects_kind_ck.name: subjects_kind_ck
subjects_kind_ck.value: ("access_subjects"."kind" = 'member' and "access_subjects"."member_id" is not null and "access_subjects"."api_key_policy_id" is null) or ("access_subjects"."kind" = 'api_key' and "access_subjects"."api_key_policy_id" is not null and "access_subjects"."member_id" is null)

policies_retention_ck.name: policies_retention_ck
policies_retention_ck.value: "workspace_policies"."grace_days" between 0 and 30 and "workspace_policies"."security_version" > 0 and "workspace_policies"."trash_retention_days" > 0 and "workspace_policies"."event_retention_days" > 0 and "workspace_policies"."delivery_retention_days" > 0 and "workspace_policies"."audit_retention_days" > 0

values_scalar_shape_ck.name: values_scalar_shape_ck
values_scalar_shape_ck.value:
("property_values"."kind" in ('text','url') and "property_values"."text_value" is not null and num_nonnulls("property_values"."number_value", "property_values"."boolean_value", "property_values"."option_id", "property_values"."date_start", "property_values"."date_time_start") = 0)
    or ("property_values"."kind" = 'number' and "property_values"."number_value" is not null and num_nonnulls("property_values"."text_value", "property_values"."boolean_value", "property_values"."option_id", "property_values"."date_start", "property_values"."date_time_start") = 0)
    or ("property_values"."kind" = 'checkbox' and "property_values"."boolean_value" is not null and num_nonnulls("property_values"."text_value", "property_values"."number_value", "property_values"."option_id", "property_values"."date_start", "property_values"."date_time_start") = 0)
    or ("property_values"."kind" = 'select' and "property_values"."option_id" is not null and num_nonnulls("property_values"."text_value", "property_values"."number_value", "property_values"."boolean_value", "property_values"."date_start", "property_values"."date_time_start") = 0)
    or ("property_values"."kind" = 'date' and num_nonnulls("property_values"."date_start", "property_values"."date_time_start") = 1 and num_nonnulls("property_values"."text_value", "property_values"."number_value", "property_values"."boolean_value", "property_values"."option_id") = 0)

values_date_shape_ck.name: values_date_shape_ck
values_date_shape_ck.value: ("property_values"."date_end" is null or ("property_values"."date_start" is not null and "property_values"."date_end" >= "property_values"."date_start")) and ("property_values"."date_time_end" is null or ("property_values"."date_time_start" is not null and "property_values"."date_time_end" >= "property_values"."date_time_start")) and ("property_values"."time_zone" is null or "property_values"."date_time_start" is not null)

collab_sizes_ck.name: collab_sizes_ck
collab_sizes_ck.value: "collaboration_documents"."encoded_bytes" between 2 and 1048576 and "collaboration_documents"."business_bytes" between 2 and 1048576 and "collaboration_documents"."journal_bytes" >= 0 and "collaboration_documents"."projection_attempts" >= 0
